Hi, I'm a new contributor and I have four small number theory PRs, all with green CI and the LLM-generated (Code with claude) label with disclosure. Could someone take a look at the first two?

  • #43749: prodPrimeFactors_one_sub without the squarefree hypothesis (one theorem, one deprecation). Reviewed by wwylele, all comments addressed.

  • #43758: Redheffer's theorem, det of the Redheffer matrix = Mertens function, new file NumberTheory/ArithmeticFunction/Redheffer.lean.

Two more are stacked on top and marked blocked-by-other-PR, for later: #43880 (inverse of the zeta matrix is the Möbius matrix) and #43884 (Smith's determinant for the gcd matrix).

Thanks!
